He plays for [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]].{{cite news |title=Nikola Mirotic ya tiene la nacionalidad española |url=http://www.marca.com/2010/03/26/baloncesto/acb/1269622221.html |work=[[Diario Marca]] |date=March 26 2010 |accessdate=July 16 2010 }} ==Pro career== Mirotić began his professional career with the [[Spanish ACB League]] club [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]]. During the [[Euroleague 2010-11]] season, he emerged as one of his team's most valuable cogs to win the [[Euroleague Rising Star]] award.[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/84950/180 Euroleague.net Real Madrid's Nikola Mirotic chosen 2011 Rising Star.] In 2011, he signed a 5 year contract extension with Real Madrid.[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/84995 Euroleague.net Real Madrid extends Mirotic through 2016.] ==Spanish national team== Mirotić has been a member of the junior national team of Spain.
